-- ID 6: 4gKNVtZ4... — on-chain ACTIVE (status byte=0), funds still locked — revert to pending so Claim button shows
UPDATE htlc_swaps 
SET status = 'pending', refundTxId = NULL 
WHERE id = 6 AND htlcAddress = '4gKNVtZ4dYHwuTXaKN2hXV3CTSzzZYs1y9KQZCbf8TZ6';

-- ID 7: 9hCF3qiW... — PDA closed on-chain but DB says 'expired' — fix to refunded
UPDATE htlc_swaps 
SET status = 'refunded', refundTxId = 'auto-detected-closed' 
WHERE id = 7 AND status = 'expired';
